summary: Benchmarks planned; results are written here only from actual runs of npm run bench:crop-profile.

benchmarks.name: Rendered corn stands: rows, pitch, phase, off-row weeds
benchmarks.dataset: Rendered scenes (scripts/cropProfiles/scenes.ts): 20, 22, 30, 36 in and twin rows; 0.3 to 4 cm; soil, red soil with straw stripes, weeds; development seeds 1 to 20, evaluation seeds 101 to 160
benchmarks.split: seeded scenes; parameters were set on development seeds only, scores reported on evaluation seeds

acceptance.metric: row lines on the crop (phase error under a quarter pitch)

benchmarks.notes: Synthetic: tests the engine against known geometry and known failure conditions, not field accuracy.

benchmarks.name: Three early-corn photos: rows found and rows on green (label-free)
benchmarks.dataset: CropTesting/Corn/earlystage (3 photos, no EXIF, no labels)
benchmarks.gsdCm: 0.2 to 0.5 (from the measured pitch and an assumed 30 in)
benchmarks.split: development: 0359 was used to diagnose the residue failure

acceptance.metric: green on the row lines against green mid-alley

benchmarks.notes: No ground truth: the on-green ratio is a proxy that rows sit on the vegetation.

benchmarks.name: WeedsGalore held-out patches: vegetation segmentation
benchmarks.split: the authors spatial split (field patches never shared between splits); band gains set on train+val only

benchmarks.name: WeedsGalore held-out patches: crop versus weed by position

acceptance.metric: weed pixels off the row band (recall of the position rule)
acceptance.threshold: reported, no target: in-row weeds are out of reach by design

acceptance.metric: maize pixels inside the row band

benchmarks.name: WeedsGalore held-out patches: between-row weed cover against labels

acceptance.metric: mean absolute error of off-row weed cover per patch

benchmarks.name: WeedsGalore dates: calendar stage estimate against the stated stages
benchmarks.dataset: WeedsGalore dates (sown 9 May 2023; first flight stated as V1)

acceptance.metric: stated stage inside the estimated range
acceptance.threshold: every date with a stated stage

failureCases.symptom: The photo pattern pass drew every row line on the straw strips between the corn rows.
failureCases.cause: On red soil with bright straw the per-window Otsu split fell to -0.20, between soil and straw; the vegetation mask covered 79% of the photo, the green row fit failed the coherence gate, and the brightness fit locked onto the straw stripes.
failureCases.fix: Corn profile ExGR gate at zero on the vegetation mask (vegetation.exgrGate): straw and soil fall below it whatever the Otsu split; brightness-found blocks re-placed on the green when it is in step (rowReader.verifyBrightnessAgainstVegetation). A floor of 0.05 on the ExG index fixed this photo but not bright yellow straw (rendered scenes), so it was replaced by the gate.
failureCases.regressionTest: src/test/cropProfilesEngine.test.ts: residue stripes on red soil

failureCases.symptom: No rows found on a clean close-up of five corn rows: every window's pitch confidence was 0.31 against a bar of 0.35.
failureCases.cause: A 4 m photo holds five rows; at the 0.76 m candidate the autocorrelation band covers about one period and its median sits near the peak. The 0.70 m candidate's band gives 0.89 on the same pixels with coherence 0.79.
failureCases.fix: Corn candidates (0.381, 0.508, 0.70, 0.762, 0.914) searched beside the crop-neutral ones.

failureCases.symptom: No rows on a 6.9 × 5.1 m photo whose whole-photo fit had confidence 0.98 and coherence 0.83.
failureCases.cause: A row block needs three usable windows; a 4 m window plan gives a photo this size two windows.
failureCases.fix: Blocks need at most as many windows as the photo has (engine, crop-neutral); corn windows of four rows (about 3 m).

failureCases.symptom: A diagnostic grade on the misplaced rows called the field 10.9% cover, action, with corn counted as weeds.
failureCases.cause: Rows in the alleys cut the band out of the straw and left the corn as off-row green.
failureCases.fix: Root cause fixed with the rows; the map grade for corn stays refused (capability weed-pressure-grade unsupported) until a continuous-row map reader passes its benchmark.

failureCases.symptom: RF-DETR and ERFNet (trained on sugar beet) call much or all of the corn 'weed'.
failureCases.fix: None: the crop profile never uses a model's crop/weed label for corn; position decides.

gaps: No independent corn field with row-line truth: row detection is benchmarked on rendered stands and checked label-free on three photos.
WeedsGalore is one German field at 0.25 cm in band composites from a multispectral camera; scores downsampled to our pixel sizes are upper bounds.
No hand-measured weeds or plant counts on corn: planting positions, stand count and weed measurement are not benchmarked.
